title: الطبّ والصحّة
subtitle: Modals of deduction
intro: English has a precise grammar for uncertainty. must have, might have, can't have — each states exactly how confident you are. Doctors, engineers and detectives live in this grammar, and so should you.للإنجليزية نحوٌ دقيق للشكّ واليقين. must have وmight have وcan't have تُحدّد بالضبط مقدار ثقتك. الأطبّاء والمهندسون والمحقّقون يعيشون في هذا النحو.
goals: I can state exactly how certain I am about the past
I can speculate about causes without claiming to know
I can describe symptoms, diagnosis and treatment
I can hear 'must've', 'might've' and "can't've" at speed

blocks.title: The certainty scale
blocks.html:
All of these describe the same past event. Only your confidence changes:

He must have forgotten. — I'm almost certain (95%)
He may / might / could have forgotten. — it's possible (30–50%)
He can't / couldn't have forgotten. — I'm almost certain he didn't (95% no)

⚠️ The opposite of must have is not mustn't have. It is can't have.
He mustn't have gone ❌ → He can't have gone ✅سُلّم اليقين كاملاً. ونقيض must have ليس mustn't have بل can't have — وهذا خطأٌ شائعٌ جدّاً.

blocks.title: Adding duration: must have been -ing
blocks.html:
Use the continuous when the activity lasted:

She must have been waiting for hours.
They might have been working on the wrong version.
He can't have been sleeping — the light was on.

Compare:
must have run — the whole action, finished
must have been running — the activity, in progressأضف المستمرّ حين يكون الفعل ممتدّاً: must have been + ing. الفرق بين فعلٍ مكتمل ونشاطٍ جارٍ.

blocks.title: Deduction about the present
blocks.html:
Drop have and you move to now:

She must be exhausted. — look at her, I'm sure
It might be a side effect. — possible
That can't be right. — I'm sure it isn't

One extra word, one different time. must be = now; must have been = then.احذف have فتنتقل إلى الحاضر. must be الآن، وmust have been حينها.

blocks.title: How it really sounds
blocks.html:
must have → musta /ˈmʌstə/
might have → mighta
could have → coulda
can't have → can'tə (the t nearly disappears)
must have been → musta bin

In a film you will hear He musta bin sleepin, never the full form. Train the ear on the reduction, not the spelling.لن تسمع الصيغة الكاملة في فيلمٍ أبداً. درّب أذنك على الاختزال لا على الإملاء.

blocks.title: The Symptom Nobody Measured
blocks.en:
For most of the twentieth century, medicine measured what was easy to measure. Temperature, blood pressure, cell counts — anything that produced a number went into the notes. Pain did not, and neither did exhaustion. A patient who said she was tired all the time was recorded as having no findings, which in practice meant she had nothing wrong with her.

We now know that must have been false for millions of people. When researchers finally built scales for fatigue and asked patients to score themselves, the results correlated closely with outcomes that nobody had connected to tiredness at all: recovery times, relapse rates, even survival. The symptom had been there the whole time. It simply can't have been seen by a system that only recorded numbers it already trusted.

The lesson generalises badly in one direction and well in another. It does not mean every subjective report is accurate; patients misremember, and self-scoring drifts. It does mean that the absence of a measurement is not evidence of the absence of a problem.

Modern clinics now ask directly and record the answer. That change cost nothing and was resisted for decades, largely because the people who might have pushed for it were the ones too exhausted to attend the meetings.
blocks.ar:
طوال معظم القرن العشرين كان الطبّ يقيس ما يسهل قياسه. الحرارة وضغط الدمّ وتعداد الخلايا — كلّ ما يُنتج رقماً كان يدخل في الملفّ. أمّا الألم فلا، ولا الإنهاك. والمريضة التي قالت إنّها متعبةٌ دائماً كانت تُسجَّل بلا موجودات، وهو ما يعني عمليّاً أنّها لا تشكو من شيء.

ونعلم اليوم أنّ ذلك لا بدّ أنّه كان خطأً بحقّ ملايين البشر. فحين بنى الباحثون أخيراً مقاييس للإرهاق وطلبوا من المرضى تقييم أنفسهم، ارتبطت النتائج ارتباطاً وثيقاً بمخرجاتٍ لم يربطها أحدٌ بالتعب أصلاً: مدد التعافي، ومعدّلات الانتكاس، بل حتّى البقاء على قيد الحياة. كان العَرَض موجوداً طوال الوقت. ولم يكن ممكناً أن يراه نظامٌ لا يسجّل إلّا أرقاماً يثق بها سلفاً.

والدرس يُعمَّم على نحوٍ سيّئ في اتّجاه وجيّدٍ في آخر. فهو لا يعني أنّ كلّ بلاغٍ ذاتيّ دقيق؛ فالمرضى يخطئون في التذكّر، والتقييم الذاتيّ ينحرف. لكنّه يعني أنّ غياب القياس ليس دليلاً على غياب المشكلة.

وتسأل العيادات الحديثة اليوم مباشرةً وتسجّل الجواب. وهو تغييرٌ لم يكلّف شيئاً وقُوبل بالمقاومة عقوداً، ويعود ذلك في معظمه إلى أنّ من كان يمكن أن يدفعوا نحوه كانوا هم أنفسهم أشدّ إنهاكاً من أن يحضروا الاجتماعات.

days.subtitle: Speculating and describing how you feel

blocks.title: Speculating out loud
blocks.html:
My guess is that … — informal, honest
It looks as though … — evidence-based
The most likely explanation is … — analytical
I'd put money on … — very confident, informal
I can't see how it could have been … — ruling out
Off the top of my head, … — without checking

Notice: English speakers speculate constantly. Refusing to guess sounds evasive, not careful.المتحدّث الإنجليزيّ يخمّن باستمرار. رفض التخمين يبدو تهرّباً لا حذراً.

blocks.title: Describing how you feel to a doctor
blocks.html:
It comes and goes. — intermittent
It's been on and off for a week.
It's a dull ache vs a sharp pain vs a burning sensation
It's worse when I lie down.
I've been feeling run-down. — generally weak
I'm not myself lately. — something is off

⚠️ I have pain in my head is understandable but not natural. Say I've got a headache.عباراتٌ عمليّة لوصف الألم. ولاحظ أنّ «I have pain in my head» مفهومة لكنّها غير طبيعيّة.

blocks.title: 🚫 لا تقل هذا
blocks.html:
❌ He mustn't have known → ✅ He can't have known
❌ I must to go to the doctor → ✅ I must go / I have to go
❌ I'm sick from two days → ✅ I've been ill for two days
❌ The doctor gave me a medicine → ✅ The doctor prescribed something / gave me some medicine
❌ I did an operation (as patient) → ✅ I had an operation
❌ My health is bad → ✅ I'm not in great health / I haven't been well

medicine is usually uncountable — no a, no medicines in everyday speech.لاحظ: المريض «had an operation» ولم «يفعلها»، وmedicine اسمٌ غير معدود في الاستعمال اليوميّ.

blocks.title: The task
blocks.prompt:
Describe a health or technical problem you or someone you know had, and reason about the cause, in 130–150 words. It must include:

• one must have and one can't have
• one might / could have been -ing
• one present deduction (must be / can't be)
• at least four words from this unit
• a final sentence that says what is still unknownصف مشكلةً صحّيّةً أو تقنيّةً واستنتج سببها في ١٣٠–١٥٠ كلمة، مع must have وcan't have وmight have been -ing واستنتاجٍ عن الحاضر وأربع كلماتٍ من الوحدة، وخاتمةٍ تقول ما لم يُعرف بعد.
phrases: The most likely explanation is that …
What we still don't know is …
blocks.model:
My mother spent four months being tired before anyone took it seriously. The first symptom was fatigue so ordinary that she blamed her sleep, then her job, then her age.

Looking at it now, it must have started long before she mentioned it. It can't have been simple overwork, because it did not improve during a three-week holiday. She might have been managing the swelling in her ankles for months without connecting the two things at all.

The GP ran bloods, ruled out infection, and made a referral. The underlying cause turned out to be treatable, which must be the only reason this story has an ordinary ending.

What we still don't know is why nobody asked a direct question for four months. My guess is that nothing about her produced a number, and a system that trusts numbers had nothing to look at.
blocks.modelAr:
أمضت أمّي أربعة أشهر متعبةً قبل أن يأخذ أحدٌ الأمر على محمل الجدّ. كان أوّل عَرَضٍ إرهاقاً عاديّاً إلى حدٍّ جعلها تلوم نومها، ثمّ عملها، ثمّ عمرها.

وبالنظر إليه الآن، لا بدّ أنّه بدأ قبل أن تذكره بزمنٍ طويل. ولا يمكن أن يكون مجرّد إرهاقٍ من العمل، لأنّه لم يتحسّن خلال إجازةٍ من ثلاثة أسابيع. وربّما كانت تتعامل مع تورّمٍ في كاحليها شهوراً دون أن تربط بين الأمرين أصلاً.

أجرى الطبيب العامّ تحاليل الدمّ، واستبعد العدوى، وكتب إحالة. وتبيّن أنّ السبب الكامن قابلٌ للعلاج، وهو ما لا بدّ أنّه السبب الوحيد في أنّ لهذه القصّة نهايةً عاديّة.

وما نزال لا نعرفه هو لماذا لم يسأل أحدٌ سؤالاً مباشراً طوال أربعة أشهر. وتخميني أنّ شيئاً فيها لم يُنتج رقماً، ونظامٌ يثق بالأرقام لم يجد ما ينظر إليه.
checklist: I used 'must have' for near-certainty about the past
I used a continuous form (might/could have been -ing)
I made one deduction about the present (must be / can't be)
I used at least four unit words (symptom, referral, rule out, underlying …)
I wrote 'had an operation', not 'did an operation'
I ended by naming what is still unknown
